item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] One pedestrian killed, another hurt in crash on SR-574 in Hillsborough County: FHP
item.description: One man was killed and another seriously injured after both were struck by an SUV while crossing State Road 574 Friday night, according to Florida Highway Patrol (FHP).
